steps.text: 3:23 P.M. \ Clear
Underneath a nondescript oak tree, outside the nomadic town of Wolumonde, Leithanien

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Schultz Severin... This is your third pack of the day.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Schultz?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Oh, sorry, Uncle...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I need my tobacco. You're right, of course. Alcohol and tobacco are bad habits. Don't be like me.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But your cough keeps getting worse.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: We're off the clock. No need to be so formal. How many times have I told you? Never mind.
He looks away. The burned tents, the weeds growing out of control. He flicks the ash from his cigarette.
He hoped to find some peace and quiet in his solitude, even if it was just a change of his title.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Sigh*... They made you come all the way out here!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The bunch of old schemers. They won't even come to me themselves. They send out a little girl to get hurt——*Cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*!

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Calm down, Uncle! I volunteered. I thought it would be better to tell you myself.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Wheeze*——*cough* *cough*, *cough* *cough*——

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: You really have to quit smoking and drinking. Look how bad you've gotten...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I've more or less figured it out. Damn it.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Well, there was a heated discussion back in council. The young people hid in the parlor. No one dared to speak.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No, no one helped me. I couldn't convince anyone on my own. I'm sorry.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: The situation has been tense since the town went off course. We don't need to be standing on ceremony anymore. Not that anyone would listen to students and kids, even if they did speak up.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And then what happened?

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The councilors agreed that because it was impossible to distinguish between Infected and the state of their infection, it's better safe than sorry...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: The bodies need to be buried outside the town. And of course... no funerals.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I... I'm sorry...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But some of them are people of Wolumonde. Our own. We can't just abandon them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Eckehard was the best tailor in town. He took over the shop from his father. We wouldn't have weddings without him.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And poor Biederman. He lost his job as a Catastrophe Messenger because of the Great Rift. But he's trying to atone. He is strong.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Kevin wasn't Infected. He worked hard for his wife. He was a good husband.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: And Thorwald, he——*cough* *cough*, *hack* *cough*——

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: No more smoking, Schultz. Thor even said so.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Can you accept it, child? Honestly? Forget what the old schemers think.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I... I don't know...

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: I just want Thor to be buried so he can rest in peace. I don't want people treating him like he's a threat when he's already dead... to be tossed out there... to the elements.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Alright.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Why do we have to treat them like that? We never did anything like that before.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: And that Oripathy doctor. She was incredible. She refused to abandon Wolumonde. All four of them have the right to a decent burial, but——

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Putting them together with the Infected——

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We should just be blaming the fire.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I know.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: But... But let's save that for later. For now, we can't just dump their remains.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I contacted the nearest Gendarmerie, and they will have experts on the rescue team to assist with the investigation. Until then, we'll keep the bodies where I can care for them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Once we have specialists on scene, we can treat the dead with appropriate care.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: We can still get help?

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They could be a month out, depending on the exact length of the rift. It could honestly be several months.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: Wolumonde is getting worse and worse every day now that we're off course. Everyone is saying we'll have to head around the whole Great Rift to get back on track.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But if the Great Rift is that big, if the detour is too long...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Anyway, we have to wait.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Give me a minute with Thor. I think... I think I'm entitled to that.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: If the old schemers want to leave my boy in the middle of nowhere, they'll have to shoot their own Schultz.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: They'll have to shoot me.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: They won't! We all know how much you've done for the town!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: ...No, forget I said that.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: I can't say that at a time like this. The Schultz can't talk like that. We have work to do.

steps.name: Tatjana
steps.text: But Thor is still your son!

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tatjana, you go back and tell them. Tell them...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tell them...

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: Tell them I agree. *Cough*. I agree with them.

steps.name: Severin
steps.text: *Cough* *cough* cough*, *cough* *cough*——

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: They came back.
Hm.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Thanks to the locals, we were able to slip into the nearby town and replenish our supplies.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: The hunters will be back soon. Hope we get something today. I'm sick of sandworms. Two days is enough.
Hm.
How about water?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Not an issue. Gotta thank them for that too.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: But seriously, I don't like talking to them. I always feel like they're looking down on me.
Hm.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: It looks like Wolumonde is going to start migrating again soon. We have to see some results by then.
We have help. It will be good.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Help...? Maybe.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: But I don't trust the local Infected. They're just out for revenge.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Leithanien is better to the Infected than most places are. And since everyone here uses Arts, they don't have much reason to fear or persecute them.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: And isn't it enough that the Infected can have a decent life here without being sent straight to the gallows?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: I think they're just a bunch of thugs, stealing our name for their own purposes—
Name?
What's in... a name?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Erm...
We don't trust them... fine. But... who do we trust? Who should we trust?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Can you stop talking so creepily? Whatever you say, captain.
...Thank you.
Oh, a leaf. It fell on your head...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Huh? What?
A few boxes of dried meat. Fresh-picked fruit. Water. It's early autumn. Still a long way to winter...
We have time.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Okay. You're still kind of confusing me with that talk.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Anyway, it's your call when to start the war.
War? No...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Huh?
Look. The hunters are back.
Seems our food will be better tonight.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: I hope so. We should eat more meat while we can. Food is going to be a big problem come winter.
Did Bob ever write back?

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Haven't heard from him since we got to Leithanien... Erm, by the way, I've been meaning to ask...

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Like, was his code name 'Bob' and they started calling him 'Big Bob' because he's a big guy, or was he 'Big Bob' from the start?
...I don't remember.

steps.name: Armed Infected
steps.text: Whatever. They're bounty hunters. Maybe they found the treasure.
Treasure. Hm.
It would be nice... if there was a treasure to help us too.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's been 27 days!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: How could she take so long to make contact? She's obsessed with punctuality!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Atro... where are you...?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Oh, Lisa... Err, I'm supposed to call you Operator Suzuran now, huh?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: It's a good code name.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Hehe, thanks!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You've been watching the communication room for 20 hours now. Aren't you going to take a break?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Has it been that long?

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Yes! So please go to the break room and get some rest. I'll take over for you.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Okay... It's really been that long...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Still no word from Atro?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: None yet. I already put in an application to go to Leithanien. If Amiya approves, I'll leave right away.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Leithanien? Don't you have work to do?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: She's my classmate, and my best friend. I can't... I won't abandon her.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Atro's last contact was with the office in northern Leithanien. Unless something big happened, she wouldn't go far from there.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Then I'll go too!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Huh?! Harsh...

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: You- you just want to find Atro, right? It won't be dangerous?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Who knows what the situation could be.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: That's okay! I'm a fully accredited operator now, and a student of Dr. Kal'tsit!

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: And I can't stand seeing my big sister Folinic's worried face all the time! I have to do something!

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: *Sigh*. I never imagined little Lisa would worry about me someday. Everything's all out of order lately.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Big or small, we all have worries.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Well, okay! I reported in to the local branch office anyway. If anything goes wrong, they'll send help.

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Let's just wait for Amiya's approval and then we'll go together. But you'll have to stay close by me.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: A message? Is it Atro?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: No. It's a brief, sent by an operator in Leithanien who received our message.

steps.name: Suzuran
steps.text: Folinic?

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: Atro was spotted in a small town in Leithanien... And about one month ago...

steps.name: Folinic
steps.text: That town suffered a Catastrophe.
